name: Nippon: Zaibatsu

categories.label: VP earned during the game (score track)
categories.labelVi: Điểm đã có trên track (gồm chấm điểm Ảnh hưởng)
categories.hint: Everything on the score track after the 3 Influence Scorings; add the 100/200/300 disc if used.

categories.label: Personal objectives VP total
categories.labelVi: Tổng điểm mục tiêu cá nhân
categories.hint: Sum of all personal objectives from your player board: six Favor-token tracks (5/8/10 VP lower, 10/16/20 VP higher threshold by level), Factories and Contracts (VP beside your rightmost built Factory / fulfilled Contract in your Favor token's level column).

categories.label: Resources and goods in total
categories.labelVi: Tổng tài nguyên và hàng hóa
categories.hint: 1 VP per 3 resource/goods tokens you have in total.

categories.label: Money (in units of 1000)
categories.hint: 1 VP per 5 units of money (a 5000 coin counts 5, a 1000 coin counts 1).

tiebreakers.description: The tied player who took their turn later (later in turn order) wins.
tiebreakers.descriptionVi: Người hòa đi lượt sau (muộn hơn trong thứ tự) thắng.

notes: family: end-game-categories (area-majority Influence scoring happens 3 times during play and lands on the score track). Final Scoring order: personal objectives, then resources/goods/money. Money unit (1 VP per 5 of the money symbol) read from the rulebook example (two 5000 coins and one 1000 coin = 2 VP); confirm in play. Objective thresholds/values depend on the printed player-board spaces, hence scorer inputs. Solo/2-player automa and Late-Game Factories module not modelled.

sources.title: Nippon: Zaibatsu rulebook
sources.section: p.19 End of the Game: Final Consolidation, Final Scoring, tie; p.18 Influence Scoring

uiHintReason: Objective rows are printed on the player board; one total replaces three entries.
winConditionVi: Điểm cao nhất thắng. Hòa thì người đi sau trong thứ tự lượt thắng.
